Energy holds the top year-to-date rank with a 0.617 momentum score, but broader market participation remains narrow, with only 2 of 11 groups showing positive returns across all measured horizons.

Short-term rotation favored rate-sensitive and defensive-tilted pockets, with Real Estate (momentum 0.650), Financial (momentum 0.550), and Utilities (momentum 0.520) each advancing +1 spot over the last five sessions. Meanwhile, core growth and cyclical sectors are fading: Technology dropped to rank 5 with a weak 0.200 momentum score, while Industrials (rank 7, momentum 0.333) and Basic Materials (rank 9, momentum 0.317) also slipped -1 spot.

- **Sustained Leadership:** Consumer Defensive and Healthcare have maintained top-3 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **YTD Leader:** Energy retains the number 1 rank year-to-date with a 0.617 momentum score, followed closely by Real Estate at rank 4 (momentum 0.650).

## Movers & Momentum

- **Top 5-Day Sliders:** Basic Materials (rank 9, momentum 0.317), Industrials (rank 7, momentum 0.333), and Technology (rank 5, momentum 0.200) each fell -1 spot.
- **Deepest Momentum Laggards:** Communication Services sits at the bottom of the board at rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.133, closely trailed by Technology (0.200) and Basic Materials (0.317).

## Divergences
- **Technology Rank vs. Momentum Mismatch:** Technology maintains an elevated year-to-date rank of 5 despite possessing the second-worst momentum profile in the market at 0.200.
- **Energy Top Rank vs. Momentum Decoupling:** Energy holds the number 1 rank overall, yet its momentum score of 0.617 significantly lags Consumer Defensive (0.933) and Healthcare (0.883).
